description: Chanter role builds for the Ascent Plan.

records.label: Mantra support
records.summary: Party buffs with Undefeated Mantra, plus solid melee damage. Undefeated Mantra is in every build.

coreSkills.name: Dark Crush
coreSkills.why: Main hit. Top players put Daevanion points into it.

coreSkills.name: Onslaught
coreSkills.why: MP filler, usable on the move. Each hit cuts the Spinning Strike cooldown from skill Lv 12.

coreSkills.name: Spinning Strike
coreSkills.why: Unlocks at Lv 14. The core buff skill.

coreSkills.name: Incandescent Blow
coreSkills.target: Lv 8, then Mastery 11, then +4 from Daevanion nodes

targetProvenance.note: Mastery stops at skill Lv 11 (mechanics.json, mastery-cap). The guide target "Lv 8 to 12" is reworded against the cap: the build names its Daevanion node (+1 on each of four boards, 139 of 178 full plans take all four).

coreSkills.name: Recuperation
coreSkills.why: Unlocks at Lv 8. Self and party recovery.

coreSkills.name: Impactful Crush
coreSkills.why: Stuns NPC targets and makes Dark Crush ready.

picks.pick: Always lands as a Critical Hit
picks.perk: Always lands as a Critical Hit
Hits cut Spinning Strike cooldown by 1s

picks.pick: Ignores Block and Evasion, lands as a Critical Hit
picks.perk: Ignores Block and Evasion, lands as Critical Hit
Up to 12% more damage when fewer targets hit

picks.pick: Ignores Block and Evasion, lands as Multi-Hit
picks.perk: Ignores Block and Evasion, lands as Multi-Hit
Extra consecutive use, heal over time stacks twice

stigmas.note: Boss fight set: Undefeated Mantra, Power of the Storm, Marchutan's Wrath, Obliterate.

priorities: Dark Crush +1 on every board you open

rows.name: Dark Crush
rows.why: Fires first when ready. Impactful Crush, Spinning Strike and Marchutan's Wrath make it ready again, so it catches every reset.

rows.name: Spinning Strike
rows.why: Critical Damage +15% for 30 s, stacking twice, and Dark Crush is ready for 2 s.

rows.why: Stuns NPC targets and makes Dark Crush ready for 2 s.

rows.name: Incandescent Blow
rows.why: Filler: always ready, so it sits last.

mainAttack.name: Onslaught
mainAttack.why: Held with the macro key: 100 MP a hit, each animation cut short. 258 of 265 published bars keep it on left click.

stackBPending.reason: No second line is sourced. Most players run one line; Onslaught, the other common step, is your main attack.

ownKeys.name: Undefeated Mantra
ownKeys.why: Toggle: switch it on and leave it on. A macro would switch it off.

ownKeys.name: Sprint Mantra
ownKeys.why: Toggle: switch it on and leave it on.

ownKeys.name: Power of the Storm
ownKeys.why: Burst buff for 10 s: press it at the start of a pull or a boss phase.

ownKeys.name: Marchutan's Wrath
ownKeys.why: A hard hit every 30 s that makes Dark Crush ready for 3 s: press it, and the macro fires Dark Crush next.

ownKeys.name: Heat Wave Blow
ownKeys.why: A 10 s hit on a pack. The macro key holds four and is full.

ownKeys.label: Stun
ownKeys.why: Tremor Crush stuns an NPC, then Wave Blow fires on the stunned target. 84 of 265 published bars share this key.

ownKeys.name: Gust Rampage
ownKeys.why: Use it in stagger windows: it only hits a staggered target.

ownKeys.name: Recuperation
ownKeys.why: Heals you and the party and clears a debuff: you choose when.

ownKeys.name: Defiance
ownKeys.why: Clears crowd control: you need it at a chosen moment.

ownKeys.name: Rushing Smash
ownKeys.why: Dash: it rushes you to the target and gives 100 MP.

ascent.why: Party buffs first, then damage; survival and MP count for a little.
